name: Meris VI
description: Meris VI was the outermost planet in the Meris system in Elrood sector. It was a frigid planet swept by constant ice storms. Meris VI had a breathable type II atmosphere in warmer seasons; in winter, the air was too cold to be safe without a heating mask filter.
